main_text.p: {?}I.xr.[?] dictionū, quoniam non amplius post eam peregrinatus est. Febriculá correptus ] Ita AlFtrauZabadius الوعك interpretatur اني الحمي Febrim leviorem, quæ tamen postea adeo invaluit, ut eâ ad delirium adactus visus fit suorum nonnullis, ac inprimis Omaro لما اشتد بالنبي مرضه الذي مات فيه قال ايتوني بدواة وقرطاس اكتب لكم كتابا لا تضلوا بعدي فقال عمر ان رسول الله قد غلبه الوجع حسبنا كتاب الله وكثر اللغط فقال النبي قوموا عني لا ينبغي عندي التنازع قال ابن عباس الرزية كل الرزية ما حال بيننا وبين كتاب رسول اللہ ut è Bocharïo AlSharefianius, i.e. Cùm inva-v.g. AbulFed. & AlJannab, & Shirhol. Mawak f & c.lesceret Prophetæ morbus, quo mortuus est, dixit, Afferte mihi atramentum & chartam, ut scribam vobis librum quò post obitum meum non erretis. Dixit Omar, Prævalnit certè dolor Apostolo Dei ; sufficit nobis liber Dei [?]. Alcoranus ]Cùm ergò multiplicarentur inter ipsos [hâc de re ]verba, ( dicentibus scil. aliis, (ut & è Bocharío refert AlJannabius) Afferte illi calamarium & chartam, aliis Omaro assentientibus,scil. nescire illum præ dolore quid diceret) Discedite à me, inquit Propheta, non enim convenit ut coram me disceptetis. Dixit Ebn Abbas, Malum, maximam certè malum quod in causa fuit ne scriberet nobis Apostolus Dei librum ipsum.

* Ad verba cùm dicit tantum superfuisse [?] noctes [seu dies] è mense Saphar.Diem obiit die Lunæ qui * 27. fuit mensis Saphar ] Juxta alios qui duodecimus Rabiæ prioris, juxtà quam sententiam (inquit AbulFeda) incidit dies mortis ejus in natalem ipsius † 27um autem Saphari diem fuisse non

page.notes: The Arabic words in the text (الوعك, اني الحمي, and the Arabic passage) are transcribed as printed, but the Arabic line breaks and the reading of "اني الحمي" and "اللہ" are doubtful and marked only in the text where they are uncertain. The margin reference "I.xr." is read with doubt. The Arabic may be printed right to left; the ordering follows the printed lines. Left-margin notes: the upper note and the "†22" note are placed at the start of the first paragraph where they stand beside it. The text ends mid-sentence; the final word "non" is the last printed word on this part. Marks "†" and "*" in the margin are symbols as printed; the lower "†" note is not separately placed.
